// === PAGE ===
#set page(
  paper: "a4",
  fill: rgb("#F8F7F0"),
  margin: (top: 0.9in, bottom: 0.5in, left: 1in, right: 1in),
  footer: context {
    set text(size: 8pt, fill: rgb("#666"), style: "italic")
    let updated = datetime.today().display(
      "Updated [month repr:long] [day padding:none], [year]"
    )
    grid(
      columns: (1fr, 1fr, 1fr),
      align(left)[#updated],
      align(center)[Page #counter(page).display() of #counter(page).final().last()],
      align(right)[#link("https://pingfan.org")[pingfan.org]],
    )
  },
)

#set text(font: ("Optima", "Helvetica Neue", "Arial"), size: 11pt)
#set par(leading: 0.55em, justify: false, spacing: 0pt)
#set block(spacing: 0pt)

// === SPACING KNOBS ===
#let gap = 5pt
#let entry-gap = 3pt

// === LISTS & TABLES ===
#show list: set block(spacing: 0.4em)
#show list: set par(leading: 0.45em)
#set list(indent: 1em, body-indent: 0.5em, marker: ([•]), spacing: 0.5em)

#show enum: set block(spacing: 0.4em)
#show enum: set par(leading: 0.45em)
#set enum(indent: 1em, body-indent: 0.5em, spacing: 0.5em)

#show list: it => { it; v(gap) }
#show enum: it => { it; v(gap) }
#show table: it => { v(3pt); it; v(gap) }

// Navy-blue links
#show link: set text(fill: rgb(0%, 20%, 60%))

// Monospace font for inline code spans
#show raw: set text(font: "Maple Mono NF", size: 0.92em)

#let section(name) = {

  line(length: 100%, stroke: 0.5pt + rgb("#888"))
  v(gap)
}

}

#section[Research Interests]

- *Data Science*: Studying human behavior in sustainable transportation with mixed logit and related discrete choice models and large-scale scenario simulation, from survey design and fielding through statistical modeling and visualization, using electric vehicle smart charging as the leading case to generate program design and policy suggestions.
- *Open-Source Software*: Development of `surveydown`, a programmable, markdown-based survey platform built on Quarto, Shiny, and PostgreSQL, its companion GUI `sdstudio`, and `TidyViz`, a Python package for tidying and visualizing survey data.
- *Agentic AI Engineering*: Building reproducible research and engineering workflows around Claude Code with plugins, skills, MCPs, and hooks, documented in public tutorials, and taught through a workshop on the GW Trustworthy AI Initiative for researchers and developers.

#section[Honors & Awards]

- #link("https://engineering.gwu.edu/building-platform-make-survey-research-more-reproducible")[2025]: Profiled by GW Engineering for contributing to the `surveydown` platform.
- #link("https://ospo.gwu.edu/2024-student-open-source-award-winners")[2024]: 2nd Prize in GW's 2024 Student Open Source Awards for the `surveydown` R package.
